Mapped provenance remains semantically unverified against sw/source/core/doc/DocumentStylePoolManager.cxx; Phase 2 preserves the bounded upstream manager boundary. Iteration102 materializes document-owned named paragraph collections instead of flattening common styles into direct node items. Supported own paragraph/character/list fields, raw names, parent/follow links and automatic deltas survive graph16, ODT cycles and actual history. Native name lookup and bounded custom CopyTextColl preserve destination ownership and manual rule handling; the prior builtin copy adapter remains unchanged. Literal zero/per-axis list masks and the project tdf114287 fixture distinguish inherited margins from hard rule overrides. Writer export retains original named parents and emits actual direct numbering items; generic legacy export remains compatible. Default paragraph items are retained on the existing Standard root adapter only. All303other prior tests remain unchanged; one inherited common-style XML assertion moves to styles.xml and one existing project fixture now asserts its actual custom owner/parent, with numeric literals unchanged. Native list display-name resolution, invalid/cyclic parent detachment, direct empty rule suppression and supported composite item subfield inheritance are retained. Full native global default pools, conditional styles, pool/help IDs, creation undo, complete UNO/style UI, collisions and geometry consumers remain separately unverified. No existing status/default/exception or registered I/O/recovery promotion.

Native character pool IDs/names/defaults and numbering registrations use actual SwCharFormat owners. Browser graph retains character identity, parents, pool IDs, auto flag, items and numbering references without name merging; paragraph pool IDs now restore losslessly too. Native numbering label projection applies represented style items after paragraph resets and before explicit bullet font. Existing InsertTable body moves unchanged to its native ndtbl.cxx owner. Related source-only and Worker roundtrip evidence does not establish compiled Writer parity; ranged style hints, HTML/CSS reader, user ConfigItem subscriptions and unrepresented item families remain open. Existing registered recovery/save/open deviations remain unchanged.
